name: Mrs. Frye
summary: Mrs. Frye proposed telephoning the neighbors when the strange noises began at the Frye farm, moments before the horror struck.
description: When the stench and barking began at the Frye farmstead, Mrs. Frye proposed telephoning the neighbors; her husband Elmer was about to agree when the noise of splintering wood burst in upon their deliberations.

sources.quote: Mrs. Frye proposed telephoning the neighbors, and Elmer was about to agree when the noise of splintering wood burst in upon their deliberations.

facts: Proposed telephoning the neighbors when the noise began.
